name: Restorationists Crest (Potentials)
composed_prompt: Centred guild crest. Painterly digital illustration, clean read at thumbnail. Negative-space ring of recursive senate-floor geometry. Material: hammered brass over bone. Single rim-light from upper left. No text on crest. Mood: "we remember the shape of the old order."

name: Restorationists Banner
composed_prompt: Long horizontal banner. Tall narrow vertical stripe of frayed cloth. Old-world senate motif at centre. No text. Mood: a flag carried out of a building that no longer stands.

name: Elara Avenmoor (Restorationists)
composed_prompt: Three-quarter portrait of Elara Avenmoor against a faded senate mural. Painterly, single key from frame-left, soft volumetric haze. Bio-mechanical Potential physiology. Mood: dignified exhaustion.

name: Reformers Crest (Potentials)
composed_prompt: Centred guild crest. Concentric rings being broken outward by a slim arrow. Material: aged copper with patina. Single key. No text. Mood: "we woke up after the Fall."

name: Reformers Banner
composed_prompt: Long horizontal banner. Concentric-rings-being-broken motif, central vertical seam where a new pattern is sewn into older cloth. No text.

name: The Human (Reformers)
composed_prompt: Three-quarter portrait of The Human against an unfinished mural. Painterly, single key from frame-right, soft haze. Mood: "pretending nothing changed would be its own kind of treason."

name: Authority's Ledger Crest (New Babylon)
composed_prompt: Centred crest. Six red-crystal coffins arranged hexagonally around a quill-and-seal. Material: oxblood lacquer over gilt. Negative-space recursive contract-clause spirals. No text. Mood: "the contract decides."

name: Authority's Ledger Banner
composed_prompt: Long horizontal banner. Hexagonal lattice of red-crystal coffin shapes. Frayed gilt fringe. No text. Hung as if from a courtroom rafter.

name: Adjudicator Locke (Authority's Ledger)
composed_prompt: Three-quarter portrait of Adjudicator Locke at a gavel-strike. Painterly, single warm 2700K key from upper-left, six red-crystal coffins faintly visible in mid-ground haze. Mood: fine-print incarnate.

name: Civic Engineers Crest (New Babylon)
composed_prompt: Centred crest. Crossed wrench and lift-cable forming a sigil. Material: ceramcrete dust on oxblood. Mood: "the lifts run while the Authority signs paperwork in their sleep."

name: Civic Engineers Banner
composed_prompt: Long horizontal banner. Tall vertical band of lift-cable woven through ceramcrete texture. Worker-grade fabric. No text.

name: Severance Division Crest (Hierarchy)

name: Severance Division Banner
composed_prompt: Horizontal banner. Cleaved-helix motif repeated twice in negative space. Sterile finish.

name: Nilmorg, SVP Kinetic Acquisition
composed_prompt: Three-quarter portrait of Nilmorg behind an institutional desk. Painterly, single cool 6500K key from above, no warm fill. Mood: precision without warmth.

name: Acquisitions Crest (Hierarchy)
composed_prompt: Centred crest. Predator's hand grasping a bound contract-scroll, blood-weave thread leaking from the seal. Material: wet chrome over bone. Mood: "files your name under leverage."

name: Acquisitions Banner
composed_prompt: Horizontal banner. Predator-hand silhouette holding a length of blood-weave. No text.

name: Drael'Mon, the Harvester
composed_prompt: Three-quarter portrait of Drael'Mon. Painterly, single warm 1800K key from frame-right, blood-weave threads faintly visible. Mood: hostile takeover incarnate.

name: Syndicate of Death Crest (Hierarchy)
composed_prompt: Centred crest. Inverted Thalorian liturgical symbol, ritual blade through it. Material: corroded ceremonial silver. Mood: "sacrificial ceremonies inverted from Thalorian liturgy."

name: Syndicate of Death Banner
composed_prompt: Horizontal banner. Inverted-liturgy motif, candle-soot smudges, ceremonial blade pattern. No text.

name: R&D Division Crest (Hierarchy)

name: R&D Division Banner
composed_prompt: Horizontal banner. Schematic-style ritual instrument repeated. Drafting-paper texture.

name: Shelf-mates Banner
composed_prompt: Horizontal banner. Long shelf-edge view, ribbons hanging between volumes. No text.

name: Daniel Cross, the Antiquarian
composed_prompt: Three-quarter portrait of Daniel Cross at a reading desk. Painterly, single warm 2700K key from frame-right, mid-ground stacks fading into haze. Mood: bibliographic order.

name: Casino Floor Banner
composed_prompt: Horizontal banner. Card-spread motif tiled. Felt texture, neon trim.

name: The Degen (Casino Floor)
